name: agilon health, inc.
summary:
agilon health, inc. (AGL) reported earnings of $1.80 per share on revenue of $1.42 billion for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.13 per share on revenue of $1.38 billion. The company beat consensus estimates by 59.29% while revenue fell 7.33% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects 2026 revenue of $5.68 billion to $5.805 billion. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $5.41 billion to $5.58 billion, and the current consensus revenue estimate is $5.46 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

agilon health is transforming health care for seniors by empowering primary-care physicians to focus on the entire health of their patients.
subject: agilon health, inc. Beat Consensus Estimates
